title: Address
description: Address object used by every party and site across all events — carrier, broker, producer, receiver, collection site, delivery site and receipt site alike. postcode is required; fullAddress is optional here and promoted to required at the point of use (see the requiredFullAddress convention) for sites that are physically visited. Accepts both UK postcodes and Irish Eircodes.

postcode.description: Accepts UK postcodes and Irish Eircodes.
